mathematical_meanings: Left image: The line plots a positive-slope linear function with x-intercept −1 and y-intercept 1. Right image: The straight segment is the diagonal connecting the lower-left and upper-right corners.
Rationales: The feature plots a linear relationship between coordinates in the left image and connects opposite vertices of a quadrilateral in the right image. The rising line crossing the axes at the marks −1 and 1. The rising straight line inside the rectangle.
